sets.label: WV
sets.description: Winter Variation: insert the last pair, already joined, and orient the corners when the edges are oriented (27 cases).

sets.label: VLS
sets.description: Valk Last Slot: insert the last pair and orient the whole last layer. Grouped by the edges already oriented; with the 27 WV cases, all 216.

sets.label: OLLCP
sets.description: Orient the last layer and permute its corners in one algorithm, leaving only an edge PLL.

sets.label: COLL
sets.description: Orient and permute the last-layer corners when the edges are oriented (40 cases), leaving only an edge PLL.

sets.label: CMLL
sets.description: Roux: solve the last-layer corners after both blocks, ignoring the M slice (42 cases).

sets.label: CLL
sets.description: Solve the whole cube in one algorithm when the first layer is solved (EG-0, 42 cases).

sets.label: EG-1
sets.description: Solve the whole cube in one algorithm when the first face has two corners swapped on one side (42 cases).

sets.label: EG-2
sets.description: Solve the whole cube in one algorithm when the first face has two diagonal corners swapped (42 cases).
